Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines using football and everyday objects.
Identified a pole as standing and a crossbar as sleeping.

Recognised that straight lines do not bend and that curved lines are different.
Teach-back was not passed; one item was answered with “pata nahi.”
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting lines and telling straight lines from curved lines. Using football examples helped them connect a pole with standing, a crossbar with sleeping, and a goalpost support with slanting; they also corrected the slide example as straight rather than curved. At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type around the room and draw it.
